name: Frostpane
summary: An eight-page frosted-glass B2B sales CRM with a deal board, quotes and invoices
about: A sales CRM for a team that sells to business customers and sends invoices, shown with sample data from an IT equipment and support company. The whole app floats in one frosted window over an aurora that shifts colour with pipeline health. Deals glide across glass columns, quotes turn into invoices, and payments fill a bar until a shining Paid ribbon drops in.
how: Use the sidebar inside the glass window to move between the eight pages; on a phone use the menu button.
On Deals, drag a chip to the next column; closing a deal offers to quote it. Keyboard users press Shift with an arrow key or use the grip.
Build a quote with line items, change its status, then press Invoice or Convert to invoice.
On Invoices, pick a row to preview it on the right, record full or part payments and watch the bar fill; a fully paid invoice gets the Paid ribbon.
Search, filter and sort accounts and contacts, open one for details, edit or delete with undo.
On Overview, switch 7D, 30D or 12M to morph the bookings chart; the sidebar health meter and aurora react as deals move.
Settings saves billing details, automations, the theme and can reset the demo data. Press Ctrl+K to search everything.
